title: Storage and indexes
summary: Match storage to the access path, and price what an index costs on writes.

parts.rule: Choose storage from the access path, then say what each index adds to write cost and space.
parts.why: Picking a trendy database without the path is cargo cult. Indexes are not free.
parts.example: SAMPLE: lookups by short code want a primary key or unique index on that code; secondary indexes on rarely filtered columns only slow writes.
parts.use: Use this when the path is known and you must justify a store or an index.
parts.refuse: Refuse a second index that does not change a named query. Refuse ignoring write amplification.

body:
Rule. Choose storage from the access path, then say what each index adds to write cost and space.

Why it matters. Picking a trendy database without the path is cargo cult. Indexes are not free.

SAMPLE example. SAMPLE: lookups by short code want a primary key or unique index on that code; secondary indexes on rarely filtered columns only slow writes.

When to use. Use this when the path is known and you must justify a store or an index.

When to refuse. Refuse a second index that does not change a named query. Refuse ignoring write amplification.
